title: Audio Serverless — Stable Audio 3.0 Small SFX / ACE-Step 1.5 (ComfyUI)
description: ComfyUI serverless worker for the video_gen audio stand: SFX, layers and music. It executes a prepared ComfyUI API audio graph built by the video_gen audio_models catalog (it never builds, edits or selects the graph or the model) and returns the produced audio plus execution-fact telemetry (engine version, model hash, seed, duration, sample rate, channels, GPU seconds, license). Model weights come from a pinned manifest on the attached network volume (sha256 verified by populate-volume.sh); nothing is baked into the image.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Maximum time a single audio job may run before the worker aborts it. Must be less than or equal to the endpoint timeout (the audio-stand target is 900 s, 1200 s recommended).

input.name: Health probe timeout (seconds)
input.description: Timeout of the single GET /system_stats probe used by the health action.

input.name: S3 endpoint
input.description: Optional S3/MinIO endpoint. Configure S3_* to return large audio as a presigned audio_url instead of inline base64.

input.name: S3 access key
input.description: S3/MinIO access key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 secret key
input.description: S3/MinIO secret key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 bucket
input.description: Bucket for large audio output (alias: OUTPUT_BUCKET).

changelog:
## v0.2.2

- Hub build fix (2nd attempt): the 48 GB test class (`NVIDIA RTX A6000` -> `A40` -> `L40`) was out of stock at build time, so the test pod still failed with `All returned supply constraints` even after the CUDA list was corrected. The build test now runs on the 24 GB class (`NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090`, CUDA 13.2) that served the TTS build. The listing GPU pools (`AMPERE_48,AMPERE_24,ADA_24`) and the host-CUDA >= 13.0 requirement for the CUDA 13.0 image are unchanged; the health test does not initialize CUDA.

## v0.2.1

- Hub build fix: `hub.json`/`tests.json` listed CUDA versions that no RunPod machine advertises (`13.1`, `13.3`, `13.4`, and only `13.0` matched nothing on the tested pools), so the Hub test pod failed with `All returned supply constraints`. The real host inventory (`GET /v2/catalog/gpus`) has `13.2`, `13.0`, `12.6`, `12.4`; the image is built on CUDA 13.0, so the listing now allows host `13.2`/`13.0` (driver >= 13.0) and GPU pools `AMPERE_48,AMPERE_24,ADA_24` (A6000/3090/4090 real stock).
- The build test (`.runpod/tests.json`) runs the health action on a stock-bearing NVIDIA RTX A6000 with CUDA 13.2.
- Unchanged: contract `audio-serverless/v1`, handler, tests, manifest and the CUDA 13.0 ComfyUI base. The ComfyUI boot entrypoint stays `TODO(live)`.

## v0.2.0

- RunPod Hub listing metadata (`.runpod/hub.json`) and the build test (`.runpod/tests.json`, `action=health`).
- Health action (contract §3): `action: health` returns `{status, comfyui, volume_mounted}`; it only probes `VOLUME_ROOT` and a short `GET /system_stats` — no model load and no graph run. Statuses `ok`/`starting`/`degraded`; ComfyUI call failures never fail health.
- Input schema allows `action: health` without `prompt`/`parameter` (additive within `audio-serverless/v1`); health contract examples and tests added.
- Version `0.2.0` (package, Dockerfile, Hub metadata); README documents the health action and Hub publishing.
- Unchanged: the generation contract `audio-serverless/v1`, telemetry facts, the pinned volume manifest and the ComfyUI base. The ComfyUI boot entrypoint and stand verification remain `TODO(live)`.

## v0.1.0

- Initial release: contract `audio-serverless/v1`, ComfyUI executor for Stable Audio 3.0 Small SFX and ACE-Step 1.5, pinned volume manifest + `populate-volume.sh`, 80 GPU-free tests.
